title: REPORT on the annual report on the activities of the European Ombudsman in 2024
part_text: 8. Highlights the Ombudsman’s vital activities in increasing transparency and helping to improve the balanced composition of the Commission’s expert groups, with a particular focus on the EU Energy Platform Industry Advisory Group, considering the high social and environmental stakes at play with regard to energy policies; strongly regrets the fact that the Commission decided to completely exclude civil society representatives from this Group, providing fossil fuel industries with privileged and unmonitored access to EU policymakers and increasing their influence on EU decision-making, thereby undermining citizens’ trust, public scrutiny and transparency; is of the opinion that EU citizens should be informed of the profiles of all members of the expert groups;
